C1393.title: Mirai Botnet Hacker Ordered to Pay $8.6 Million in Damages
C1393.summary: A 22-year-old hacker was sentenced by a U.S. federal court to pay $8.6 million in damages and serve six months of home confinement for assisting in a series of large-scale DDoS attacks powered by the Mirai botnet. The hacker participated in building botnets from compromised IoT devices and launching attacks against targets including Dyn, causing major internet disruptions.
